what: Local runs (26 November, this repository's scripts/gf2_invariant_search.c on orbit files made by prepare_mixed) of symmetric decompositions of GF(2^12) multiplication invariant under a Frobenius power, with forms over two subfields at once; label = q*100 + orbit size.

GF(4) and GF(2) forms, x -> x^4 (step 2).complete: every profile of this cost with at most 1e7 choices; the class has 1575 profiles and 7.7e16 choices in all

GF(8) and GF(2) forms, x -> x^8 (step 3).complete: no: 28 of the profiles with at most 1e8 choices, smallest first
